name: Grupa Azoty S.A.
summary: Grupa Azoty S.A. manufactures and sells fertilizers, plastics, and other chemicals in Poland, Germany, South America, Asia, other European Union countries, Rest of Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Plastics, Chemistry, Power Industry, Agro, and Other segments.
